slides.title:
AI is good at the part
we're *bad* at.
slides.body:
And bad at the part
we're good at.

slides.title: Good at
slides.body:
Reading *everything*.
Every log, every config,
every ticket from three years.

slides.title: Why that matters
slides.body:
No human does that
on page four hundred.
No human was ever going to.

slides.title: Bad at
slides.body:
Knowing what matters *here*.
This estate.
This night.

slides.title: It will tell you
slides.body:
An interface reset
*forty times*
last month.

slides.title: It won't tell you
slides.body:
That interface feeds a warehouse
running a day shift.
The resets land at *2am*.

slides.title: It will flag
slides.body:
Config drift on a device
nobody has rebooted
since 2021.

slides.title: It won't know
slides.body:
That's the thing
you should be *fixing*.

slides.title: Where that context lives
steps: In the heads of people who have been there a while.
It is the actual product of *experience in one place*.

slides.title: AI reads your environment.
slides.body:
It doesn't understand
your *business*.
Staff for the difference.

Follow *@mzsnetworks*
